NOTE: Clients are advised to follow up the next working day, pending documents due to unusual

SERVICE PLEDGE: The City Mayor’s Office commits itself to deliver efficient, effective and
economical governance promotive to the general welfare of the constituency.

FEEDBACK AND COMPLAINTS MECHANISM      Answer the client feedback form and drop it at the

How feedback are processed             Desk located at the City Hall Lobby
How to file a complaint                The person in charge opens the drop box and evaluate
                                       each feedback requiring answers are forwarded to
